items.title: 1.5.1 Properties of four Fourth Roots of Unity (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Is sabaq mein hum unity ke chaar fourth roots ki chaar khoobiyan (properties) dekhenge, aur phir ek aisi misaal hal karenge jo cube roots (\(\omega\)) ki properties use karti hai. Pichle sabaq mein humne dekha tha ke unity ke chaar fourth roots yeh hain: \(1, -1, +i, -i\). Ab inhein jama, zarb aur jori bana kar dekhte hain.
(i) Sum of all the four fourth roots of unity is zero
Yani chaaron fourth roots ka jor zero hai. Wajah seedhi hai: \(1\) aur \(-1\) ek doosre ko khatam karte hain, aur \(i\) aur \(-i\) bhi.

blocks.text_alt: because 1 plus minus 1 plus i plus minus i equals 0

blocks.text: (ii) The real fourth roots of unity are additive inverses of each other

Yani real fourth roots ek doosre ke additive inverse hain. \(1\) aur \(-1\) unity ke real fourth roots hain aur \(1 + (-1) = 0 = (-1) + 1\). Additive inverse ka matlab hai woh number jise jorne se jawab 0 aa jaye, jaise kisi ke 5 rupay udhaar hon aur woh 5 rupay wapas kar de to hisaab barabar (zero).
(iii) Both the imaginary fourth roots of unity are conjugate of each other

Yani dono imaginary fourth roots ek doosre ke conjugate hain. \(i\) aur \(-i\) unity ke imaginary fourth roots hain, jo zahir hai ke ek doosre ke conjugates hain. Conjugate ka matlab hai sirf imaginary part ka sign ulat dena; Argand diagram par yeh real axis mein aaine ki tarah aks (mirror image) hai: \(i\) upar \((0, 1)\) par aur \(-i\) theek us ke neeche \((0, -1)\) par.
(iv) Product of all the fourth roots of unity is −1
Yani chaaron fourth roots ka zarb \(-1\) hai:

blocks.text_alt: 1 times minus 1 times i times minus i equals minus 1

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Additive inverse: aise do numbers jin ka jor 0 ho. Conjugate: \(a + bi\) ka conjugate \(a - bi\) hai; \(0 + 1i\) ka conjugate \(0 - 1i\) hai, is liye \(i\) aur \(-i\) conjugates hain.
Product \(-1\) kyun aaya? Do do ki jori mein multiply kijiye: \(1 \times (-1) = -1\), aur \(i \times (-i) = -i^{2} = -(-1) = 1\). Ab dono jawab multiply karein: \(-1 \times 1 = -1\).
Dhyan dein: cube roots ka product 1 tha, fourth roots ka \(-1\) hai. In dono ko mila dena aam ghalti hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Neeche wali Example 11 kitab ne isi jagah chhapi hai, lekin yeh fourth roots par nahin balke cube roots of unity (\(\omega\)) aur 1.4.1 ki properties par hai. Is liye pehle yeh do baatein taaza kar lein: \(\omega^{3} = 1\) aur \(\omega + \omega^{2} = -1\).

blocks.title: Example 11
steps:
Given: \(\omega\) unity ka ek complex cube root hai.
To prove: \(x^{3} + y^{3} = (x + y)(x + \omega y)(x + \omega^{2}y)\).
Method: sab se pehle yeh dekhte hain ke kis side se shuru karna aasan hai. Left side (L.H.S) chhoti hai, us mein karne ko kuch nahin. Right side (R.H.S) mein teen brackets hain jinhein khol kar simplify kiya ja sakta hai. Qaida yeh hai ke proof mein hamesha mushkil (lambi) side se shuru karte hain aur use aasan side tak le aate hain. Hum aakhri do brackets multiply karenge aur \(\omega^{3} = 1\), \(\omega + \omega^{2} = -1\) (1.4.1 se) use karenge, taa ke saare \(\omega\) gayab ho jayein.

Step 1: Aakhri do brackets multiply karein
\[\text{R.H.S} = (x + y)(x + \omega y)(x + \omega^{2}y)\]
\[(x + \omega y)(x + \omega^{2}y)\]
\[= x^{2} + \omega^{2}xy + \omega xy + \omega^{3}y^{2}\]
\[= x^{2} + (\omega + \omega^{2})xy + \omega^{3}y^{2}\]
Is tarah \(\text{R.H.S} = (x + y)[x^{2} + (\omega + \omega^{2})yx + \omega^{3}y^{2}]\).
Kyun: do do brackets kar ke multiply karna sab se mehfooz hai. Pehli term \(x \cdot x = x^{2}\), aakhri \(\omega y \cdot \omega^{2}y = \omega^{3}y^{2}\), aur beech ki do terms mein \(xy\) common nikaala to \((\omega + \omega^{2})xy\) bana. Yeh beech ki terms jaan boojh kar ikatthi ki hain, kyun ke humein maloom hai ke \(\omega + \omega^{2}\) ki value aasan hai. (Kitab yahan pehli term \(x\) chhapti hai; misaal ke baad "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye.)

Step 2: Cube roots of unity ki properties lagayein
\[\omega^{3} = 1,\quad \omega + \omega^{2} = -1\]
\[\text{R.H.S} = (x + y)(x^{2} - xy + y^{2})\]
Kyun: \((\omega + \omega^{2})xy = (-1)xy = -xy\) aur \(\omega^{3}y^{2} = 1 \cdot y^{2} = y^{2}\). Dekhiye, saare \(\omega\) gayab ho gaye aur ek aam algebraic expression bach gaya. \(\omega\) wale sawalon ka yahi raaz hai: properties laga kar \(\omega\) ko khatam karna.

Step 3: Multiply kar ke simplify karein
\[= x^{3} - x^{2}y + xy^{2} + x^{2}y - xy^{2} + y^{3}\]
\[= x^{3} + y^{3} = \text{L.H.S}\]
Kyun: \(x\) ko bracket ki teenon terms se aur phir \(y\) ko teenon terms se multiply kiya. Beech ki terms jori mein khatam ho gayin: \(-x^{2}y + x^{2}y = 0\) aur \(xy^{2} - xy^{2} = 0\). Yeh wahi mashhoor identity hai \(a^{3} + b^{3} = (a + b)(a^{2} - ab + b^{2})\), jo aap pichli classes mein parh chuke hain. R.H.S, L.H.S ke barabar aa gaya, yani saabit ho gaya.

Tasdeeq:
Ek aasan value rakh kar dekhte hain: \(x = y = 1\). L.H.S \(= 1 + 1 = 2\).
R.H.S \(= 2(1 + \omega)(1 + \omega^{2}) = 2(1 + \omega + \omega^{2} + \omega^{3})\)
\[= 2(0 + 1) = 2\]
Dono sides barabar hain. (Yahan \(1 + \omega + \omega^{2} = 0\) aur \(\omega^{3} = 1\) use hue.) Yeh check proof ki jagah nahin le sakta, lekin ghalti pakarne mein madad karta hai.
blocks.answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(x^{3} + y^{3} = (x + y)(x + \omega y)(x + \omega^{2}y)\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hal ki doosri line mein kitab \((x + y)[x + (\omega + \omega^{2})yx + \omega^{3}y^{2}]\) likhti hai; bracket ki pehli term \(x\) nahin balke \(x^{2}\) hai, kyun ke \(x \cdot x = x^{2}\). Sahi line: \((x + y)[x^{2} + (\omega + \omega^{2})yx + \omega^{3}y^{2}]\). Kitab ki agli line \((x + y)(x^{2} - xy + y^{2})\) mein sahi \(x^{2}\) hai, is liye proof ka natija durust hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Isi tarah ka ek chhota kaam khud kar ke dekhiye (yeh kitab ka sawal nahin): \((x + \omega y)(x + \omega^{2}y)\) ko simplify karein.
Step 1 ki tarah: \(x^{2} + (\omega + \omega^{2})xy + \omega^{3}y^{2} = x^{2} - xy + y^{2}\).
Yani yeh do brackets mil kar hamesha \(x^{2} - xy + y^{2}\) bante hain. Yeh natija yaad rakhiye, Exercise 1.4 mein bohat kaam aayega.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Unity ke fourth roots: \(1, -1, i, -i\).
2. Jor \(= 0\); zarb \(= -1\).
3. \(1, -1\) ek doosre ke additive inverse hain; \(i, -i\) ek doosre ke conjugate hain.
4. Cube roots ke saath: \(x^{3} + y^{3} = (x + y)(x + \omega y)(x + \omega^{2}y)\), jo \(\omega^{3} = 1\) aur \(\omega + \omega^{2} = -1\) se saabit hota hai.
5. Proof mein lambi side se shuru karein aur \(\omega\) ko properties se khatam karein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Fourth roots ka product \(+1\) samajhna: \(i \times (-i) = -i^{2} = +1\), lekin \(1 \times (-1) = -1\), is liye kul product \(-1\) hai.
2. \(\omega\) wale proofs mein \(\omega^{3}\) ko 1 aur \(\omega + \omega^{2}\) ko \(-1\) se badalna bhool jana; phir sawal aage nahin barhta.
3. Brackets multiply karte waqt \(x \cdot x\) ko \(x\) likh dena (kitab ki tarah); \(x \cdot x = x^{2}\).
4. Cube roots aur fourth roots ki properties mila dena: cube roots ka product 1, fourth roots ka \(-1\); dono ka jor 0.
